newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent edges higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent edges higher in thin trade.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures were unchanged on Thursday in extremely thin business, traders said.
August Brent was just three cents firmer at 1215 GMT and was trading at $17.97 a barrel, while August gas oil was unchanged at $161.75.
"It is very quiet - there is nothing going on. It is a Friday," one trader said.
Dealers were awaiting a meeting due on Sunday between the U.N. Iraq coordinator and Iraqi officials for further talks on Baghdad's aid distribution plan.
Prices fell sharply on Thursday when the German government said it planned to sell oil from its reserves in order to qualify for Europe's single currency.
Bonn said on Friday it would sell 2.8 million barrels of oil in the next few weeks and dispose of its entire strategic reserves of 7.3 million tonnes of crude oil.
